title: Backup size growth versus previous backup
description: Consider only successful backups. For each backup, use LAG to find the previous backup for the same database_name in finished_seq ASC, then id ASC order. Return exactly five columns: database_name, backup_id, size_mb, previous_size_mb, growth_mb, where growth_mb = size_mb - previous_size_mb. Keep only rows with growth_mb of at least 100. Sort by database_name ASC, then backup_id ASC.
starter_sql:
WITH history AS (
    SELECT database_name, id AS backup_id, size_mb
    FROM backups
    WHERE status = 'success'
)
hints: LAG(size_mb) should partition by database_name and order by finished_seq, id.
Filter the difference in the outer query after previous_size_mb has been calculated.
solution_explanation: LAG relates each successful backup to its predecessor inside the same database; the CTE then lets us filter the calculated growth.
